Title: Product Analytics Senior Manager
Description: Your mission in the Data Analytics team: TouchTunes is looking for a Senior Manager, Product Analytics to own how we measure and improve our consumer product. In this senior individual contributor role, you’ll set the measurement strategy for the product organization and do the hardest analysis yourself: take an open question, like why conversion is weak on one platform, and return a ranked, sized set of causes, each with an owner, a value, and a fix. You will define the product analytics roadmap, shape the experimentation program, and own the technical foundation that makes it credible, from experimentation in LaunchDarkly to tracking in Segment and Mixpanel, and build the self-service tools product needs to answer routine questions on its own. Based in Guadalajara and reporting to the Director, Data Analytics, you’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, Marketing, and Finance. Your day-to-day: Define the product analytics roadmap and KPI framework, and help set targets for installs, activation, retention, and revenue per player Shape the experimentation program: which bets to test, in what order, what each is worth, and what the portfolio has returned Serve as the go-to analytical partner for product managers and designers, pressure-testing hypotheses to inform prioritization, including when the answer is not to build Get ahead of the roadmap by sizing opportunities, segmenting users and venues, and modeling changes like pricing before engineering time is committed Own funnel and feature analysis across the mobile app, from install to first purchase, separating user drop-off from engineering defects and measurement artifacts Design and read A/B tests in LaunchDarkly, using quasi-experimental methods where a clean test isn’t possible, and raise the standard for flag setup and exposure logging Own the Segment tracking plan with Product and Engineering, specifying events before development and QA’ing them in development and production Drive event hygiene across Segment and Mixpanel, reconcile product metrics to Databricks and the finance warehouse, and resolve identity-resolution breaks Build self-service measurement: Mixpanel boards, Databricks dashboards, and reusable funnel and test-readout templates Write clear readouts for Product, Engineering, and executive audiences, and mentor analysts without direct reports Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s in statistics, data analytics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field 6+ years in product or growth analytics, including 3+ supporting a consumer product organization and 2+ owning measurement methodology or an analytics roadmap Deep hands-on expertise in Mixpanel or Amplitude, including funnels, cohorts, custom events, and dashboards other teams rely on Strong SQL against large event datasets in Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery Depth in experimentation (power analysis, guardrails, CUPED, quasi-experimental design) with hands-on LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, or Statsig experience Experience owning a tracking plan on a CDP such as Segment, including schemas, governance, and downstream destinations Proficiency in Python for analysis and automation Fluent written and spoken English for daily work with teams in New York and Montreal Required Skills/Competencies: Turns a question like conversion is down into a ranked, sized set of causes with named owners Makes causal claims only where the design supports them, and says so plainly where it doesn’t Spots measurement windows contaminated by a live test, release, or tracking change, and picks the clean baseline over the convenient one Moves a roadmap with evidence, including with stakeholders who prefer a different answer Comfortable telling Engineering something is broken, with evidence specific enough to act on Closes measurement gaps rather than working around them, with a bias toward self-service and automation Uses AI tools across the analytics workflow, from exploring data to drafting write-ups to building reusable workflows for the team A good sense of humor for tight deadlines Preferred Skills/Competencies: Consumer mobile app experience with in-app purchases, including iOS and Android differences AppsFlyer or a similar MMP Music or entertainment industry experience What’s in it for you: At TouchTunes, your work impacts our customers as part of interesting projects that transform the in-venue entertainment industry. We foster open communication and collaboration across all levels, with approachable leaders that value all voices and empower you to excel and innovate. Our team thrives in an environment where fun meets hard work, and everyone is encouraged to be their authentic selves. TouchTunes is the world’s largest in-venue interactive music and entertainment platform, we’re all about sparking joy and human connection. That moment in a bar where someone at the next table cues the jukebox to play your favorite song? That’s what we do – our platform plays millions of songs daily – but we’re also so much more! We just bought the largest soft-tipped darts business in the United States, we’re reinventing our mobile app for launch later this year, and we’re operating nearly 100,000 connected devices across North America and Europe. We’re innovators, strategic thinkers, people making the future possible today – and what a great time to join our team. 🌈TouchTunes is a proud ally of QueerTech and DiversityJobs.

Title: Senior Data Systems Operations Developer
Description: Job Description As a Senior Data Systems Operations Developer, you'll work in an expert role to diagnose and resolve performance issues with slow SQL. You'll encounter a variety of interesting problems and find ways to solve them rapidly and effectively. You should be familiar with Oracle SQL tuning, database waits classes and wait events, and performance views and reports such as ASH and AWR. The core skill needed for this role is SQL tuning. Oracle Database internals knowledge and schema related experience are secondary, but occasionally valuable. You will be hands-on in your approach, often modifying SQL by hand and running test timings to see the results, then implementing hints or other changes to resolve problems. You will have partners in both USA and Australia to enable round-the-clock response coverage. When not working on SQL tuning and deeper database investigations, you may have opportunities to work on small to medium sized functionality improvements and database related projects. Every day is a little different, but every day is focused on improving SQL performance and improving the customer experience. A positive desire to learn, listen, think, test, and fix problems daily is essential to success. So is a desire to rapidly and independently solve problems. You need to be very capable with SQL, and good at finding metadata to track down a hunch or hypothesis. You should be comfortable with index access paths, joins, and response times. A solid knowledge of data structures and algorithms is helpful. The position can be Performance DBE or Senior Performance DBE, depending on expertise and experience. Responsibilities Qualifications/Skills: Required: B.S. in computer engineering or equivalent work experience Solid knowledge of Oracle database internals At least 8 years hands-on experience in performance tuning, database development, software engineering, or database engineering; or directly related SQL tuning experience in other roles such as QA or SRE Or 6 years with master’s degree Or 3 years with PhD Proficiency in SQL and extensive experience with database driven applications Excellent communicator in both technical and non-technical contexts A passion for performance optimization work. You love to improve system scalability through smart iteration, intelligent testing, logically sound proof-of-concept work, and innovation A focus on designing for reliable and repeatable results, from the design stage through testing and into production A mindset focused on the importance of testing to validate working designs, discovering new and better configurations, and generating data that guides decision making with demonstrations of value A desire to delight the customer by taking initiative, responsibility, and ownership of your projects SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, or ASP environment work experience Recommended: Exadata and/or RAC experience. Agile/Scrum development experience. Enterprise business application development experience. Experience working on defining and refining requirements. Title: Senior Software Engineer
Description: ABOUT EARNIN As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey. EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products. As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly. POSITION SUMMARY Join our DevelSoper Experience team to design and ship AI-native tooling and agentic workflows that meaningfully accelerate the way EarnIn engineers build, ship, and operate software, and help set a new bar for what engineering productivity looks like. This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. WHAT YOU'LL DO Draw on firsthand experience with the friction, toil, and frustrations that slow engineering teams down and use that empathy to build tools and automation that actually solve the right problems. Drive the design, development, and implementation of tools, systems, and processes that accelerate engineering velocity, reduce manual effort, and raise the quality bar for software delivery. Use the latest AI capabilities LLM APIs, agentic workflows, MCP patterns, and AI-assisted development environments to fundamentally rethink what a high-productivity engineering team looks like. Architect and operate multi-step agentic systems with well-defined inputs, outputs, validation checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop guardrails that run reliably at scale. Embed AI-assisted capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows to improve build reliability, code quality feedback loops, and developer toil reduction. Guide and advise product engineering teams on best practices for building observable, scalable systems acting as a force multiplier across the org, not just within DevX. Partner directly with engineering teams to identify high-friction workflows, translate them into structured AI-assisted automation, and measure impact against defined success metrics. Instrument AI-powered features with end-to-end logging, monitoring, evaluation, and their lifecycle from pilot through iteration or retirement. Document patterns, usage guidance, and best practices so proven workflows can be consistently adopted and extended across the org. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building infrastructure or internal tooling for developer teams; fluency in Python or Go. Firsthand experience with the tools, workflows, and pain points of software engineering teams; you've felt the friction yourself and know how to fix it. Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic or LLM-powered systems in production, including practical familiarity with MCP patterns, tool-augmented workflows, or multi-step agent architectures. Some experience integrating with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) and an understanding of tradeoffs around context management, latency, cost, and safety. Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms, including building custom workflows, reusable actions, or automation that operates on code or pull requests. Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent); treat these as core to how you work, not a nice-to-have. Ability to define meaningful metrics for AI-assisted tooling and run time-bound experiments to validate impact. Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable advising and influencing partner engineering teams in a distributed environment.
